title: Moroccan Potato Gratin
description: A flavorful and comforting side dish featuring roasted potatoes, infused with the warmth of Moroccan spices.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the potatoes and enough cold water to cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and let them cool slightly.
In a large bowl, combine the olive oil, garlic, cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Add the cooled potatoes and toss to coat.
Transfer the potatoes to a 9x13-inch baking dish and top with the Gruyère cheese (if using).
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or cilantro) if desired.
